topic: Finding your third number: how many months you could cover your must-pays with the money you can reach today
pillar: The Three Numbers (what's coming in, what goes out, how many months you could keep going). Boring Money Monday.
caption:
How many months could you keep going? That is your third number, and you can find it today.
Add up the money you can reach right now.
Add up your monthly must-pays from last month's statement.
Divide the first by the second, then write it down with the date.
Save this for a quiet twenty minutes this week.
The free Three Numbers Starter Sheet gives you one page for all three. Link in bio.

slides.title: How many months could you keep going?
slides.subtitle: A 20-minute look at your third number

slides.title: Meet your third number
slides.body: The third of the Three Numbers is how many months you could cover your must-pays with the money you have now. Today you find it. All you need is a phone or a laptop.

slides.title: Add up the money you can reach
slides.body: Open your banking apps and write down what you see today.
items: Count only money that is yours to use right now
If a settlement is pending, a licensed pro can help sort what counts

slides.title: Add up your monthly must-pays
slides.body: Grab last month's bank statement. Must-pays are the bills that keep the lights on.

slides.title: Divide the first by the second
slides.body: Example with made-up numbers: 3,000 dollars you can reach, 1,500 dollars in must-pays each month. 3,000 divided by 1,500 is 2. That is two months.

slides.title: Write it down with today's date
slides.body: Put the number at the top of a page. Whatever it is, it is information. You can decide what to do with it on another day. Finding it is the whole task for today.

slides.title: Want a page to write it on?
slides.body: Save this for your next quiet twenty minutes. The free Three Numbers Starter Sheet has a spot for all three numbers. It is at the link in bio. Day one counts.
